source.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֡וא שָׁלַ֡ח מְרֹדַ֣ךְ בַּ֠לְאֲדָן בֶּֽן־בַּלְאֲדָ֧ן מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל סְפָרִ֥ים וּמִנְחָ֖ה אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע כִּ֥י חָלָ֖ה וַֽיֶּחֱזָֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: At the time that sent Merodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon letters and a gift to Hezekiah, and he had heard that he had been sick and had become strong.

en.L: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard that he had been sick and had become strong [again].
en.B: About that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, the king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah. He had heard that Hezekiah had been ill and had regained his strength.
en.R: At about that time, the king of Babylon heard that Hezekiah had been sick and had gotten well. The king's name was Merodach-baladan son of Baladan. He sent Hezekiah letters and a gift.

es.L: En aquel tiempo Merodac-baladán hijo de Baladán, rey de Babilonia, envió cartas y un regalo a Ezequías, porque había oído que había estado enfermo y se había recobrado.
es.B: Por aquel tiempo Merodac-baladán hijo de Baladán, rey de Babilonia, envió cartas y un regalo a Ezequías. Había oído que Ezequías había estado enfermo y que había recobrado las fuerzas.
es.R: Por aquel tiempo el rey de Babilonia oyó que Ezequías había estado enfermo y que se había sanado. El rey se llamaba Merodac-baladán hijo de Baladán. Le envió a Ezequías cartas y un regalo.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, Merodak-Baladân fils de Baladân, roi de Babylone, envoya des lettres et un présent à Ézéchias, car il avait appris qu’il avait été malade et qu’il avait repris des forces.
fr.B: À cette époque, Merodak-Baladân, fils de Baladân, roi de Babylone, envoya des lettres et un présent à Ézéchias. Il avait appris qu’Ézéchias avait été malade et qu’il s’était rétabli.
fr.R: Vers cette époque, le roi de Babylone a appris qu’Ézéchias avait été malade et qu’il avait guéri. Ce roi s’appelait Merodak-Baladân fils de Baladân. Il a envoyé à Ézéchias des lettres et un cadeau.

sw.L: Wakati huo Merodaki-baladani mwana wa Baladani, mfalme wa Babeli, alituma barua na zawadi kwa Hezekia, kwa maana alikuwa amesikia kwamba alikuwa ameugua na kupata nguvu [tena].
sw.B: Karibu wakati huo Merodaki-baladani mwana wa Baladani, mfalme wa Babeli, alimtumia Hezekia barua na zawadi. Alikuwa amesikia kwamba Hezekia alikuwa mgonjwa na amepata nguvu tena.
sw.R: Karibu wakati huo, mfalme wa Babeli alisikia kwamba Hezekia alikuwa mgonjwa, naye amepona. Jina la mfalme huyo lilikuwa Merodaki-baladani mwana wa Baladani. Akamtumia Hezekia barua na zawadi.

decisions.choice: Merodach-baladan king of Babylon: Marduk-apla-iddina II, a Chaldean ruler who fought Assyria for control of Babylon
decisions.reason: He ruled Babylon from 722 to 710 BC and again briefly in 703 BC, and twice led revolts against Assyria. His embassy to Hezekiah fits that history: he was looking for allies in the west against Assyria. 2 Kings 20:12 spells the name Berodach-baladan.

decisions.choice: the name has a written form and a read form
decisions.reason: The Hebrew margin gives a reading of the king's name slightly different from the spelling in the text. Both name the same king.

decisions.choice: he had heard that he had been sick and had become strong: the reason for the embassy as it was given
decisions.reason: The illness gave the occasion for the letters. 2 Chronicles 32:31 adds that the envoys came to ask about the sign done in the land, and that God left Hezekiah to test him.

decisions.choice: the king of Babylon heard ... He sent Hezekiah letters and a gift.
decisions.reason: Readable puts the cause first and gives the king's name in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: Merodac-baladán
decisions.reason: Isaiah's Hebrew spells the name with M, so every level has "Merodac-baladán", where 2 Kings 20:12 has "Berodac-baladán" as its own Hebrew does, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "Merodaki-baladani"
decisions.reason: Isaiah's Hebrew spells the king's name with M where 2 Kings has B, so the Swahili follows each book, as the terms note settles; Isaiah also adds that Hezekiah had recovered.

decisions.choice: "Merodak-Baladân", where 2 Kings 20:12 has "Berodak-Baladân"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of Isaiah spells the name with M, as the English does; the terms note sets this form.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂמַ֣ח עֲלֵיהֶם֮ חִזְקִיָּהוּ֒ וַיַּרְאֵ֣ם אֶת־בֵּ֣ית נְכֹת֡וֹ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף֩ וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֨ב וְאֶת־הַבְּשָׂמִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת׀הַשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַטּ֗וֹב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־בֵּ֣ית כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִמְצָ֖א בְּאֹֽצְרֹתָ֑יו לֹֽא־הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־הֶרְאָ֧ם חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּבֵית֖וֹ וּבְכָל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And rejoiced over them Hezekiah, and he showed them the house of his treasure, the silver and the gold and the spices and the oil the good, and all the house of his weapons, and all that was found in his storehouses; not was a thing that not showed them Hezekiah in his house and in all his realm.

en.L: And Hezekiah rejoiced over them, and he showed them his treasure house, the silver and the gold and the spices and the good oil, and all his armory and all that was found in his storehouses. There was not a thing in his house and in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.
en.B: Hezekiah welcomed them gladly and showed them his treasury: the silver and the gold, the spices and the fine oil, his whole armory, and everything to be found in his storehouses. In his palace and across his whole kingdom, there was nothing he did not let them see.
en.R: Hezekiah was happy to see the messengers. He showed them all the silver and gold, the spices, and the expensive olive oil in his treasure house. He showed them all his weapons and everything else in his storerooms. He let them see everything in his palace and in his whole kingdom.

es.L: Y Ezequías se alegró por ellos, y les mostró la casa de su tesoro, la plata y el oro, y las especias y el aceite fino, y toda la casa de sus armas, y todo lo que se hallaba en sus almacenes. No hubo cosa en su casa ni en todo su dominio que Ezequías no les mostrara.
es.B: Ezequías los recibió con alegría y les mostró la sala de su tesoro: la plata y el oro, las especias y el aceite fino, todo su arsenal y todo lo que había en sus almacenes. No hubo nada en su palacio ni en todo su reino que no les dejara ver.
es.R: Ezequías se alegró de ver a los mensajeros. Les mostró toda la plata y el oro, las especias y el aceite de oliva fino que tenía en la sala del tesoro. Les mostró todas sus armas y todo lo demás que había en sus almacenes. Les dejó ver todo lo que había en su palacio y en todo su reino.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias se réjouit à leur sujet, et il leur montra sa maison du trésor, l’argent et l’or, et les aromates et l’huile fine, et toute sa maison des armes, et tout ce qui se trouvait dans ses magasins ; il n’y eut rien qu’Ézéchias ne leur montrât dans sa maison et dans tout son domaine.
fr.B: Ézéchias accueillit les envoyés avec joie et leur fit voir sa salle du trésor : l’argent et l’or, les aromates et l’huile fine, tout son arsenal, et tout ce qui se trouvait dans ses magasins. Dans son palais et dans tout son royaume, il n’y eut rien qu’il ne leur montrât.
fr.R: Ézéchias a été content de voir les messagers. Il leur a montré tout l’argent et l’or, les aromates et l’huile d’olive précieuse de sa salle du trésor. Il leur a montré toutes ses armes et tout ce qu’il y avait dans ses réserves. Il leur a fait voir tout ce qu’il y avait dans son palais et dans tout son royaume.

sw.L: Naye Hezekia akawafurahia, akawaonyesha nyumba ya hazina yake, fedha na dhahabu na manukato na mafuta mazuri, na nyumba yote ya silaha zake, na vyote vilivyoonekana katika ghala zake. Hakuna kitu katika nyumba yake na katika milki yake yote ambacho Hezekia hakuwaonyesha.
sw.B: Hezekia aliwapokea kwa furaha, akawaonyesha nyumba yake ya hazina: fedha na dhahabu, manukato na mafuta mazuri, ghala lake lote la silaha, na kila kitu kilichokuwa katika ghala zake. Katika ikulu yake na katika ufalme wake wote hakukuwa na kitu ambacho hakuwaonyesha.
sw.R: Hezekia alifurahi kuwaona wajumbe hao. Akawaonyesha fedha yote na dhahabu, manukato, na mafuta ya zeituni ya bei ghali yaliyokuwa katika nyumba yake ya hazina. Akawaonyesha silaha zake zote na kila kitu kingine kilichokuwa katika ghala zake. Aliwaacha waone kila kitu katika jumba lake na katika ufalme wake wote.

decisions.choice: rejoiced over them: was glad at their coming
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 20:13 has a verb that differs by one letter: Hezekiah "listened to them". Both readings show a king pleased to be courted by a foreign power.

decisions.choice: his treasure house and his armory: the wealth and the military strength of the kingdom
decisions.reason: Showing a foreign envoy one's treasure and weapons was a way of proving one's worth as an ally. The treasury had been emptied to pay Sennacherib (2 Kings 18:15-16), so this display may belong to the years after the Assyrian crisis or be part of it; the text does not say.

decisions.choice: the good oil: fine olive oil, a costly product kept in royal stores
decisions.reason: Fine oil was a valued trade good and was stored with spices and precious metals (2 Chronicles 32:27-28).

decisions.choice: palace
decisions.reason: Balanced says "palace" for the king's house; Literal keeps "house".

decisions.choice: se alegró por ellos
decisions.reason: Isaiah's Hebrew reads "rejoiced over them" where 2 Kings 20:13 reads "listened to them"; the Spanish of Kings changes only this verb.

decisions.choice: "akawafurahia"
decisions.reason: Isaiah has "rejoiced over them" where 2 Kings has "listened to them"; the Swahili follows Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "se réjouit"
decisions.reason: Isaiah's Hebrew reads "rejoiced over them" where Kings reads "listened to them"; French follows each book.

source.text: וַיָּבֹא֙ יְשַׁעְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו מָ֥ה אָמְר֣וּ׀הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּמֵאַ֨יִן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ מֵאֶ֧רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֛ה בָּ֥אוּ אֵלַ֖י מִבָּבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Isaiah the prophet to the king Hezekiah and said to him, what did they say the men these, and from where do they come to you? And said Hezekiah, from a land distant they have come to me, from Babylon.

en.L: And Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What did these men say, and from where do they come to you?" And Hezekiah said, "From a distant land they have come to me, from Babylon."
en.B: Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah and asked him, "What did these men say? And where did they come from to visit you?" Hezekiah answered, "They came to me from a faraway country, from Babylon."
en.R: Then the prophet Isaiah went to King Hezekiah. He asked, "What did these men say? Where did they come from?" Hezekiah answered, "They came from a country far away. They came from Babylon."

es.L: Y el profeta Isaías vino al rey Ezequías y le dijo: «¿Qué dijeron estos hombres, y de dónde vienen a ti?». Y Ezequías dijo: «De una tierra lejana han venido a mí, de Babilonia».
es.B: Entonces el profeta Isaías fue a ver al rey Ezequías y le preguntó: «¿Qué dijeron estos hombres? ¿Y de dónde vinieron a visitarte?». Ezequías le respondió: «Vinieron a mí de un país lejano, de Babilonia».
es.R: Entonces el profeta Isaías fue a ver al rey Ezequías. Le preguntó: «¿Qué dijeron estos hombres? ¿De dónde vinieron?». Ezequías le respondió: «Vinieron de un país lejano. Vinieron de Babilonia».

fr.L: Et Isaïe le prophète vint auprès du roi Ézéchias et lui dit : « Qu’ont dit ces hommes, et d’où viennent-ils vers toi ? » Et Ézéchias dit : « D’un pays lointain ils sont venus vers moi, de Babylone. »
fr.B: Alors le prophète Isaïe vint trouver le roi Ézéchias et lui demanda : « Qu’ont dit ces hommes ? D’où sont-ils venus te voir ? » Ézéchias répondit : « Ils sont venus me voir d’un pays lointain, de Babylone. »
fr.R: Alors le prophète Isaïe est allé voir le roi Ézéchias. Il lui a demandé : « Qu’ont dit ces hommes ? D’où venaient-ils ? » Ézéchias a répondu : « Ils venaient d’un pays très loin d’ici. Ils venaient de Babylone. »

sw.L: Naye Isaya nabii akaja kwa mfalme Hezekia, akamwambia, "Watu hawa walisema nini, na wametoka wapi kuja kwako?" Naye Hezekia akasema, "Wamekuja kwangu kutoka nchi ya mbali, kutoka Babeli."
sw.B: Kisha nabii Isaya alikuja kwa mfalme Hezekia, akamwuliza, "Watu hawa walisema nini? Na wametoka wapi kuja kukutembelea?" Hezekia akajibu, "Walikuja kwangu kutoka nchi ya mbali, kutoka Babeli."
sw.R: Kisha nabii Isaya alikwenda kwa mfalme Hezekia. Akamwuliza, "Watu hawa walisema nini? Walitoka wapi?" Hezekia akajibu, "Walitoka nchi ya mbali. Walitoka Babeli."

decisions.choice: a distant land: Babylon, far to the east beyond the desert
decisions.reason: Hezekiah answers only the second question and says nothing of what the envoys said. The phrase "from a distant land" echoes what the Gibeonites claimed in Joshua 9:6-9 when they sought a treaty with Israel.

source.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֥ה רָא֖וּ בְּבֵיתֶ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּבֵיתִי֙ רָא֔וּ לֹֽא־הָיָ֥ה דָבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הִרְאִיתִ֖ים בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, what did they see in your house? And said Hezekiah, all that [is] in my house they saw; not was a thing that not I showed them in my storehouses.

en.L: And he said, "What did they see in your house?" And Hezekiah said, "All that [is] in my house they saw; there was not a thing in my storehouses that I did not show them."
en.B: He asked, "What did they see in your palace?" Hezekiah replied, "They saw all that is in my palace. In my storerooms there is not a thing I failed to show them."
en.R: Isaiah asked, "What did they see in your palace?" Hezekiah said, "They saw everything in my palace. I showed them everything in my storerooms."

es.L: Y dijo: «¿Qué vieron en tu casa?». Y Ezequías dijo: «Todo lo que [hay] en mi casa vieron; no hubo cosa en mis almacenes que no les mostrara».
es.B: Isaías preguntó: «¿Qué vieron en tu palacio?». Ezequías respondió: «Vieron todo lo que hay en mi palacio. No hay nada en mis almacenes que no les haya mostrado».
es.R: Isaías le preguntó: «¿Qué vieron en tu palacio?». Ezequías le dijo: «Vieron todo lo que hay en mi palacio. Les mostré todo lo que hay en mis almacenes».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Qu’ont-ils vu dans ta maison ? » Et Ézéchias dit : « Tout ce qui [est] dans ma maison, ils l’ont vu ; il n’y a rien dans mes magasins que je ne leur aie montré. »
fr.B: Isaïe demanda : « Qu’ont-ils vu dans ton palais ? » Ézéchias répondit : « Ils ont vu tout ce qu’il y a dans mon palais. Il n’y a rien dans mes réserves que je ne leur aie montré. »
fr.R: Isaïe a demandé : « Qu’ont-ils vu dans ton palais ? » Ézéchias a répondu : « Ils ont vu tout ce qu’il y a dans mon palais. Je leur ai montré tout ce qu’il y a dans mes réserves. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Waliona nini katika nyumba yako?" Naye Hezekia akasema, "Waliona vyote vilivyomo katika nyumba yangu; hakuna kitu katika ghala zangu ambacho sikuwaonyesha."
sw.B: Akauliza, "Waliona nini katika ikulu yako?" Hezekia akajibu, "Waliona vyote vilivyomo katika ikulu yangu. Hakuna kitu katika ghala zangu ambacho sikuwaonyesha."
sw.R: Isaya akauliza, "Waliona nini katika jumba lako?" Hezekia akasema, "Waliona kila kitu katika jumba langu. Niliwaonyesha kila kitu kilichomo katika ghala zangu."

decisions.choice: they saw everything: Hezekiah's answer repeats the narrator's words in verse 2
decisions.reason: Hezekiah answers openly, using almost the same words the narrator used. The repetition sets up the word of judgment that follows: all that they saw will be carried away (verse 6).

decisions.choice: Isaiah asked
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker.

en.B: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Listen to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies:
en.R: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Listen to this message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies:

es.B: Entonces Isaías le dijo a Ezequías: «Escucha la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos:
es.R: Entonces Isaías le dijo a Ezequías: «Escucha este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos:

sw.B: Kisha Isaya akamwambia Hezekia, "Sikiliza neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi:
sw.R: Kisha Isaya akamwambia Hezekia, "Sikiliza ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi:

decisions.choice: Yahweh of hosts: the fuller title
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 20:16 has only "the word of the LORD". The fuller title (see 1:9) stresses the power of the God who now speaks against the display of armies and treasure.

source.text: הִנֵּה֮ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִים֒ וְנִשָּׂ֣א׀כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּבֵיתֶ֗ךָ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר אָצְר֧וּ אֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ עַד־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה בָּבֶ֑ל לֹֽא־יִוָּתֵ֥ר דָּבָ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, days [are] coming, and will be carried off all that [is] in your house and that have stored up your fathers until the day this, to Babylon; not will be left a thing, says Yahweh.

en.L: Look, days are coming when all that [is] in your house, and that your fathers have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon; not a thing will be left, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Look, a time is coming when all that is in your palace, everything your ancestors have laid up until today, will be hauled off to Babylon. Not one thing will remain, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Someday everything in your palace will be taken away to Babylon. All the treasures your ancestors saved up until now will be taken. Nothing will be left. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says.

es.L: He aquí que vienen días en que todo lo que [hay] en tu casa, y lo que tus padres han atesorado hasta este día, será llevado a Babilonia; no quedará nada, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Mira, se acerca el tiempo en que todo lo que hay en tu palacio, todo lo que tus antepasados han guardado hasta hoy, será llevado a Babilonia. No quedará nada, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Algún día todo lo que hay en tu palacio será llevado a Babilonia. Se llevarán todos los tesoros que tus antepasados guardaron hasta ahora. No quedará nada. Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Voici, des jours viennent où tout ce qui [est] dans ta maison, et ce que tes pères ont amassé jusqu’à ce jour, sera emporté à Babylone ; il n’en restera rien, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le temps vient où tout ce qui est dans ton palais, tout ce que tes ancêtres ont amassé jusqu’à aujourd’hui, sera emporté à Babylone. Il n’en restera rien, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Un jour, tout ce qu’il y a dans ton palais sera emporté à Babylone. Tous les trésors que tes ancêtres ont mis de côté jusqu’à aujourd’hui seront emportés. Il ne restera rien. C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui le dit.

sw.L: Tazama, siku zinakuja ambapo vyote vilivyomo katika nyumba yako, na vile walivyoweka akiba baba zako mpaka siku hii, vitachukuliwa mpaka Babeli; hakitabaki kitu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Tazama, wakati unakuja ambapo vyote vilivyomo katika ikulu yako, kila kitu ambacho babu zako wameweka akiba mpaka leo, vitachukuliwa mpaka Babeli. Hakitabaki hata kitu kimoja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Siku moja kila kitu kilichomo katika jumba lako kitachukuliwa mpaka Babeli. Hazina zote ambazo babu zako walikusanya mpaka sasa zitachukuliwa. Hakuna kitakachobaki. Hivyo ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anavyosema.

decisions.choice: carried off to Babylon: the first word in Isaiah of exile to Babylon
decisions.reason: At this time Babylon was a small power looking to Judah for help against Assyria. The word looks ahead more than a century to Nebuchadnezzar, who carried off the treasures of the temple and palace (2 Kings 24:13; 25:13-15). From chapter 40 on, Isaiah speaks to the people in that exile.

decisions.choice: your fathers: your ancestors, the earlier kings of Judah
decisions.reason: The treasures had been stored up by the kings before Hezekiah.

decisions.choice: dice el SEÑOR
decisions.reason: As the terms note asks, the wording of 2 Kings 20:17 ("dice") is kept where the Hebrew is the same.

source.text: וּמִבָּנֶ֜יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצְא֧וּ מִמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹלִ֖יד יִקָּ֑חוּ וְהָיוּ֙ סָרִיסִ֔ים בְּהֵיכַ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And some of your sons who will come forth from you, whom you will father, they will take, and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

en.L: And some of your sons who will come out from you, whom you will father, they will take, and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
en.B: Some of your descendants, born of your own line, will be taken away, and they will serve as eunuchs in the palace of the Babylonian king."
en.R: Some of your own descendants will be taken away. They will be made eunuchs and will serve in the palace of the king of Babylon."

es.L: Y de tus hijos que saldrán de ti, que tú engendrarás, tomarán, y serán eunucos en el palacio del rey de Babilonia».
es.B: Algunos de tus descendientes, nacidos de tu propia sangre, serán llevados, y servirán como eunucos en el palacio del rey de Babilonia».
es.R: Se llevarán a algunos de tus propios descendientes. Los harán eunucos, y servirán en el palacio del rey de Babilonia».

fr.L: Et parmi tes fils qui sortiront de toi, que tu engendreras, on en prendra, et ils seront eunuques dans le palais du roi de Babylone. »
fr.B: On prendra certains de tes descendants, nés de ta propre lignée, et ils seront eunuques dans le palais du roi de Babylone. »
fr.R: On emmènera certains de tes propres descendants. On fera d’eux des eunuques, et ils serviront dans le palais du roi de Babylone. »

sw.L: Na baadhi ya wana wako watakaotoka kwako, utakaowazaa, watawachukua, nao watakuwa matowashi katika jumba la mfalme wa Babeli."
sw.B: Baadhi ya wazao wako, watakaozaliwa katika ukoo wako mwenyewe, watachukuliwa, nao watakuwa matowashi katika jumba la mfalme wa Babeli."
sw.R: Baadhi ya wazao wako mwenyewe watachukuliwa. Watahasiwa na kufanywa matowashi, nao watatumika katika jumba la mfalme wa Babeli."

decisions.choice: your sons: your descendants, the royal family after you
decisions.reason: Sons often means descendants. The words "who will come from you, whom you will father" stress that it will be Hezekiah's own line. Daniel 1:3 tells of young men of the royal family taken to serve in the palace of Babylon.

decisions.choice: eunuchs: castrated servants at a foreign court
decisions.reason: The word can mean any high court official (it is used of Potiphar, a married man, in Genesis 39:1), but in a foreign king's palace, of captives taken from a royal family, it most likely means eunuchs, as at 56:3-4.

decisions.choice: will be made eunuchs and will serve
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what being eunuchs in the palace means.

records.literal_gloss: And said Hezekiah to Isaiah, good [is] the word of Yahweh which you have spoken. And he said, for there will be peace and stability in my days.

en.L: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "Good [is] the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that you have spoken." And he said, "For there will be peace and stability in my days."
en.B: Hezekiah answered Isaiah, "This word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that you have brought is good." He was thinking, "At any rate there will be peace and stability as long as I live."
en.R: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "This message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that you have given me is good." He said this because he thought, "At least there will be peace and safety while I am alive."

es.L: Y Ezequías dijo a Isaías: «Buena [es] la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que has hablado». Y dijo: «Porque habrá paz y estabilidad en mis días».
es.B: Ezequías le respondió a Isaías: «Es buena esta palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que me has traído». Pues pensaba: «Al menos habrá paz y estabilidad mientras yo viva».
es.R: Ezequías le dijo a Isaías: «Este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que me has dado es bueno». Lo dijo porque pensaba: «Por lo menos habrá paz y seguridad mientras yo esté vivo».

fr.L: Et Ézéchias dit à Isaïe : « Elle [est] bonne, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que tu as dite. » Et il dit : « Car il y aura paix et stabilité pendant mes jours. »
fr.B: Ézéchias répondit à Isaïe : « Cette parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que tu m’as transmise est bonne. » Il pensait en effet : « Du moins, il y aura paix et sécurité tant que je vivrai. »
fr.R: Ézéchias a dit à Isaïe : « Ce message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que tu m’as donné est bon. » Il a dit cela parce qu’il pensait : « Au moins, il y aura la paix et la sécurité pendant toute ma vie. »

sw.L: Naye Hezekia akamwambia Isaya, "Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulilolinena ni jema." Naye akasema, "Kwa maana kutakuwa na amani na uthabiti katika siku zangu."
sw.B: Hezekia akamjibu Isaya, "Neno hili la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulilolileta ni jema." Kwa maana alikuwa akiwaza, "Angalau kutakuwa na amani na uthabiti maadamu ningali hai."
sw.R: Hezekia akamwambia Isaya, "Ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulionipa ni mzuri." Alisema hivyo kwa sababu aliwaza, "Angalau kutakuwa na amani na usalama wakati ningali hai."

decisions.choice: and he said, for: he said to himself, at least
decisions.reason: The second "he said" introduces Hezekiah's own reasoning, which may have been thought rather than spoken. The small word that begins it can give a reason ("for") or be emphatic ("surely", "at least"). 2 Kings 20:19 has "Is it not so, if there will be peace and truth in my days?"

decisions.choice: good is the word: Hezekiah accepts the judgment
decisions.reason: He submits to God's word, as Eli did (1 Samuel 3:18). His relief that the disaster will not come in his own lifetime is told without comment; the reader is left to weigh it.

decisions.choice: peace and stability: safety and security
decisions.reason: The second word is the one that means faithfulness in 38:3, 18-19. Paired with peace it means firmness or security: things will hold steady.

decisions.choice: He was thinking
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that the second "he said" is Hezekiah's inner thought (m1).

decisions.choice: He said this because he thought, "At least
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the link between the two sayings (m1).

decisions.choice: "Kwa maana kutakuwa na amani"
decisions.reason: Isaiah's Hebrew reads "for there will be peace" where 2 Kings has the question "is it not good, if..."; the Swahili follows Isaiah.
